newsitem.title: UK: LME copper edges lower in evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME copper edges lower in evening session.

text.p: Copper prices on the London Metal Exchange edged slightly lower during the LME's evening session on Wednesday.
At 1800 GMT, the red metal was indicated at $2,264/$2,268 about $4.00 under the kerb close but still well ahead of Tuesday's $2,258 close.
Traders said they expected a period of volatility ahead of tight December dates and did not rule out a test of recent eight month highs of $2,285.
They also noted the New York market will be closed on Thursday and Friday for Thanksgiving.
Aluminium also drifted back after earlier peaking at $1,556 It was indicated at $1,543/$1,545 at 1800 GMT.
Several traders still believed aluminium could move higher over the coming weeks, against the backdrop of uptrending charts, consumer demand and recent declines in LME inventories.
